interface.longDescription: A.S.F.R.E.E coordinates authorized AI/software forensics and supervised engineering through M00 and O01–O12. PRE Standalone and RPEDS are two first-class manifestations of one jointly evolved roadmap DNA. RPEDS remains the native A.S.F.R.E.E roadmap workstream with its four modules and M00 integration. The RPEDS Adaptive Functional Situational Adapter maps shared capabilities to local SOP, authority, security, privacy and data boundaries. M00 remains the sole case-level coordinator; O11 retains authorization/security/privacy, O12 independent evaluation judgment, O10 test/verification, and O09 supported runtime. Source and package upgrades are separate from host adoption; live cross-host updates require verified event delivery, host credentials, tests and read-back.
